payload.summary: Treat FRANK adaptive visual familiarity as a closed-loop controller with evidence-tier admission. Synthetic stress testing plus primary continual-test-time-adaptation analogues support retaining the owner-fixed ban on BRONZE self-predictions as direct training truth. Unknown rejection degrades before known-class accuracy, so MVC-E4 poisoning and MVC-E5 open-set rejection should be coupled.

branch_actions.frank: Preserve sensor truth vs familiarity separation and explicit UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS/CONFLICT escalation.
branch_actions.claycode: Ensure existing semantics can encode learner version, evidence tier, candidate/current state, open-set result, promotion/rejection, budget and rollback receipts; do not redesign unless an executable counterexample appears.
branch_actions.unifieddb: Persist learner/prototype versions, evidence lineage, calibration and rollback state without converting predictions into canonical observations.
branch_actions.claygraph: Represent observation, familiarity candidate, confirmed entity, training example and derived prediction as distinct relation/evidence types with ancestry visibility.
branch_actions.harness: Jointly execute MVC-E4 and MVC-E5; add self-ancestry contamination rate as a learner-health metric.
